category_edits.rationale: Test the specified 64-interaction causal window consistently in training, validation and prediction. The supplied baseline uses 20, so this increases context rather than reducing it. Preserve chronological ordering, padding, GRU topology, readout, loss and optimizer; existing metadata stores the updated length.

change_summary: Set the causal history window to 64 and align the embedded predictor fallback. Existing metadata propagates the window to prediction.
